components.label: api
responsibilities: Expose typed run requests, results, and supported runtime operations.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own task execution or IO implementations.

requires.rationale: The facade delegates run setup and execution.
The existing Python API exposes run contexts.
The existing Python API exposes generator operations.

components.label: contracts
responsibilities: Define runtime-owned run requests, results, and worker-plan types.
forbidden_responsibilities: Import concrete tasks, workers, or connectors.

components.label: storage
responsibilities: Own run-local state such as memstore handles.
forbidden_responsibilities: Schedule tasks or execute DSL expressions.

components.label: logging
responsibilities: Provide runtime logging and run timing without task policy.
forbidden_responsibilities: Import tasks, workers, or descriptor orchestration.

components.label: evaluation
responsibilities: Evaluate DSL expressions and user scripts in an explicit namespace.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own run state, task scheduling, or external clients.

components.label: contexts
responsibilities: Hold run and iteration context without orchestration policy.
forbidden_responsibilities: Start workers or construct external clients.

requires.rationale: Run contexts hold run-local memstore state.
Contexts delegate expression and script execution.
Contexts report run events through runtime logging.

components.label: tasks
responsibilities: Execute descriptor steps and choose workers per Generate statement; ask IO to read or write through its public boundary.

requires.rationale: Tasks operate on explicit execution context.
Tasks access run-local stores through context-owned state.
Tasks report execution through runtime logging.

components.label: lifecycle
responsibilities: Prepare, invoke setup, log, and complete descriptor runs.
forbidden_responsibilities: Implement source connectors or DSL grammar.

requires.rationale: Run lifecycle accepts and returns typed runtime values.
Run lifecycle starts the setup task.

rules.rationale: Task execution cannot depend back on the run facade or lifecycle.
